title: Q2 2026 manager prep - People Ops
content:
Purpose: notes for 1:1 with Lena (manager) - summarize recent wins, risks, asks, and career development plan. Draft / scratchpad, will clean up before sending.

Accomplishments (since last 1:1):
- Launched updated hiring scorecard template (pilot with infra hires) - saw faster alignment in interview calibration sessions. Need to collect acceptance-rate delta after 6 weeks.
- Rolled out new onboarding checklist automated in HRIS for new ICs (pilot: ENG & SRE teams). Early NPS + feedback: onboarding checklist + buddy pairing = +0.4 pts (small sample).
- Negotiated pilot with vendor for L&D stipend management (saves ~10% admin time).
- Delivered Q1 headcount reconciliation to finance on time; found 3 stale contractor entries (fixed).

Goals (Q2):
- Hiring: close open reqs for infra/platform (4 hires) - primary blocker: offer timeliness and counteroffers. Need: faster approvals from hiring managers; propose a SLAs doc.
- Onboarding 2.0: extend checklist to Managers (manager-first-day) + automated equipment checklist. KPI: reduce time-to-first-deploy to 21 days.
- Diversity hiring experiment: run two job postings with modified language / sourcing; target 20% more diverse slate for eng roles. Measure: slate diversity and conversion rates.
- HRIS migration: finalize vendor selection + migration plan; aim for minimal downtime and data validation scripts.
- Ops playbooks: complete 3 playbooks (offer approvals, contractor offboarding, performance-cycle reminders).

Risks / blockers:
- Hiring approval delays (finance sign-off loop) - proposal: 24h SLA for standard offers; escalate flow for >24h. Need Lena's support to get buy-in from finance.
- HRIS migration timeline unclear; PM bandwidth constrained. Ask: temporary contractor (2w) to accelerate vendor integration and test scripts.
- Manager adoption for onboarding checklist is patchy; managers ignoring parts. Plan: quarterly manager training + reminder cadence.

Feedback for manager / asks:
- Can you help prioritize the finance SLA for offer approvals? Quick wins here would materially reduce time-to-offer.
- Approve budget for a short-term contractor (~$8k) to help with HRIS testing and data cleanup (2-3 weeks).
- Recommend a stake in Exec review to present hiring constraints + proposed SLAs next month.

Career / growth notes (for calibration):
- Short term: want to own the HRIS vendor migration end-to-end (project lead). Aligns with ops/infra adjacent work I enjoy.
- Medium term (12-18m): move toward head of Global People Ops (scope with more cross-functional strategy) - would like mentorship on vendor negotiations and org design.
- Skill development request: budget for a 1:1 coach on org design + a spot in the strategic HR leadership course (estimate $4k).

Performance highlights to call out (for calibration conversations):
- Reduced average time-to-fill for critical infra roles in pilot by ~8 days (pilot stage).
- Improved onboarding checklist adoption in two teams; anecdotal manager feedback positive.
- Successful cross-functional mediation on a sticky offer renegotiation case.

Open questions / things to think about in 1:1:
- Tradeoffs for faster offers vs. higher initial salary needed to beat counteroffers - what risk tolerance do we have given budget?
- How aggressive do we want with diversity experiments before scaling? (pilot size, signal thresholds)
- Escalation path for people ops SLAs - who signs off? Ops leadership? Finance? Legal?

Immediate to-dos after 1:1:
- Draft finance SLA doc and share with Lena + CFO point of contact (Ethan helps).
- If approved, open req for 2-3 week contractor via vendor X.
- Schedule manager onboarding training session for May 12; invite product and eng managers.
- Collect acceptance-rate data and onboarding NPS to report next week.

Notes to self / rough phrasing to use in email to Lena: "Quick summary: hiring friction still our biggest drag on velocity - seeking your help to get finance SLA and a short-term contractor to unblock HRIS migration. Also want to discuss career stretch into vendor-led migrations."

Random scratch / fragments:
- Slack threads to link: #people-ops-pulse (hiring updates), #eng-recruiting (interview feedback).
- Confluence pages to update after migration decisions: /people-ops/hiring-guides, /people-ops/onboarding-playbook.
- Draft subject line for follow-up email: "Hiring SLA + HRIS contractor - follow up from 1:1"

End of draft. Will format and send 1-2 hours before 1:1.
